title: Prafulla Kumar Mukherjee v. Bank of Commerce

content.caseIdentity: Prafulla Kumar Mukherjee v. Bank of Commerce, AIR 1947 PC 60
content.holding: Pith and substance determines competence; if the true nature of the law falls within a competent list entry, incidental encroachment on an unauthorized list does not invalidate the statute.
content.relevance: Privy Council landmark on pith and substance in Indian federalism.
